notes.title: Pre-Devlog
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Just a short announcement (before the next devlog).
I finished the 3d printer, now you will be able to print objects almost like in real life (with the same effect and also data from a real 3d printer slicer).
[previewyoutube=HYLpJ0EDOWU;full][/previewyoutube]
Next thing I will work is on soldering components on PCBs, and after that, I hope to have a game update in April or May.

Best regards,
Cristian

notes.title: Preparing for first release after recreating it from 0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
It's been a while since I made a post here, but last year I decided, after learning more, to revive (no matter what) the game. 

Now I know a lot more about games, releasing games, game dev and more, so I feel more prepared now than ever.

I already finished the in-game computer - from where you can buy parts. I also added an app "Apps Hub" from where you can install/uninstall apps that you will later need in the game, depending on what you are doing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34904481/d860befff8e63129f87e2b9154d93038ef1e35a7.jpg[/img]

I also worked on the assembly mechanic, but it's not finished yet
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34904481/fa3f1eb9840958d50dffae790eef6c5848b8db0b.jpg[/img]

I hope for a release of the new version before June this year.

And I will also try to make either a devlog every 2 weeks (or so), or post announcements like this one.

Thanks everyone who supported me! And also to those who didn't, you feedback motivated me even more :)

notes.title: PreUpdate #1
notes.notes:
Hello,
Hope you all are doing fine!
I want to show you what I've done in the past few days.

I added a new object to build. It's a... house, a tiny house. You will get an email to build a house like this, but not at your property. You will need to build it at the owner's property. The same model can be used to build a container farm (like Square Roots by Kimbal Musk).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34904481/dbec6f09769a729b2fffaa07a87a597d72b4cd46.jpg[/img]

You can buy the materials from the scrapyard.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34904481/c92fce594786d69973044f7ff0c680aa28d1fa51.jpg[/img]

To build that, you will need other tools than the ones that are already in the game, so I added new ones.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34904481/c446c8ade20dfb3796380e73294cd72556e7d80d.jpg[/img]

This is just an informative post, the update is not available yet. I want to add more and more things. By the way, would you like to build computers?
I plan to add to install/mount solar panels on houses. And maybe to repair cars, but that is just an idea.

I also fixed some bugs, but I already made a few small updates for those bugs.

Best regards,
Cristi

notes.title: Fix #1
notes.notes:
Hi,
Today I saw that the game had a few bugs (major bugs) but fortunately, I was able to fix them fast.
[list]
[*] The first one was at the market, you couldn't buy anything and because of that, everyone died. This is fixed now.
[*] The second one was with the builder, it wasn't saving the progress. It's fixed too, and I also added to can "Cancel" the current object by pressing 'C' and get your parts back.
[*] The third one was with orders, you could order even if the basket was empty.
[*] And the final one was with some trees that didn't have colliders/collision.
[/list]

And I saw that some people didn't know that 'E' is for interacting with objects and because of that, I added a text on the screen 'Press [E] to ....'.

All of them are fixed and please if you find a bug (or more), post on "Discussions".

Best regards,
Cristi
